groups.title: Hardware
groups.description: Core building blocks EMS reads and controls.

groups.title: Features
groups.description: Optional behaviors you can turn on when you need them.

groups.title: Advanced / System settings
groups.description: System-level and expert tuning. Most users can keep the defaults.

sections.title: System basics
sections.description: Controls whether EMS is allowed to run, write to hardware, and how often the control loop updates.

fields.label: EMS control enabled
fields.description: Turns EMS live control on or off. Disable this when you want EMS installed without actively controlling devices.

fields.label: Dry run
fields.description: Runs the control logic without sending hardware writes. Useful for checking a setup safely.

fields.label: Simulation mode
fields.description: Uses simulated values instead of real hardware. Useful for development and testing.

fields.label: Allow hardware writes
fields.description: Allows EMS to send control changes to devices. Turn this off for read-only validation.

fields.label: Repair device state on startup
fields.description: Allows EMS to correct known device state values when it starts.

fields.label: Restore AC mode on startup
fields.description: Checks and restores the expected AC mode when EMS starts.

fields.label: Restore smart mode
fields.description: Checks and restores the expected device smart mode for live EMS control.

fields.label: Log level
fields.description: Controls how much detail EMS writes to the log. Use info for normal operation.

fields.label: Total output limit
fields.description: Maximum total AC output EMS may request across all devices.

fields.label: Global per-device cap
fields.description: Upper safety cap applied to each device. Most users should configure the device output limit in the Devices section instead.

fields.label: Grid deadband
fields.description: Ignores very small grid power changes to avoid constant tiny adjustments.

fields.label: Minimum output limit
fields.description: Lowest output value EMS should request when a device needs to stay active.

fields.label: Control interval
fields.description: Time between EMS control updates. Lower values react faster but can increase load and device traffic.

fields.label: Load deadband
fields.description: Ignores small measured load changes before calculating a new target.

fields.label: Target deadband
fields.description: Avoids tiny target changes that would cause unnecessary device updates.

fields.label: Filter load signal
fields.description: Smooths measured grid power before EMS reacts to it.

fields.label: Filter method
fields.description: Chooses the smoothing method for grid power measurements.

fields.label: Median window
fields.description: Number of samples used by the median filter. Higher values smooth more but react slower.

fields.label: EMA strength
fields.description: Controls how strongly recent measurements affect the smoothed value.

fields.label: Fast response on direction change
fields.description: Lets EMS react faster when grid power changes from import to export or back.

fields.label: Direction change threshold
fields.description: Minimum change needed before fast response is triggered.

fields.label: Filter reset factor
fields.description: Controls how much the filter is reset during a fast response event.

fields.label: Enable output ramp
fields.description: Limits how quickly the total output target may change.

fields.label: Ramp up speed
fields.description: Maximum increase of total output per control cycle.

fields.label: Ramp down speed
fields.description: Maximum decrease of total output per control cycle.

fields.label: Enable per-device ramp
fields.description: Limits how quickly each single device target may change.

fields.label: Device ramp up speed
fields.description: Maximum increase per device and control cycle.

fields.label: Device ramp down speed
fields.description: Maximum decrease per device and control cycle.

fields.label: Large import bypass
fields.description: Lets EMS react more aggressively when the home imports a lot of power.

fields.label: Large export bypass
fields.description: Lets EMS react more aggressively when the home exports a lot of power.

fields.label: Bypass ramp multiplier
fields.description: Multiplies ramp speed during large import or export bypass handling.

fields.label: Telemetry max age
fields.description: Maximum age of device telemetry before EMS treats it as stale.

fields.label: Stale telemetry ramp factor
fields.description: Reduces ramp speed when telemetry is stale.

fields.label: Redistribute limited power
fields.description: Moves unused output capacity from limited devices to devices that can still provide power.

fields.label: Weight by PV size
fields.description: Uses configured PV size to influence how output is shared between devices.

fields.label: Balance PV charging
fields.description: Helps keep battery-backed devices closer together while charging from PV.

fields.label: Charge balance deadband
fields.description: Difference that must be exceeded before PV charge balancing reacts.

fields.label: Full battery bias
fields.description: Bias used when one battery is much closer to full than another.

fields.label: Charge balance strength
fields.description: How strongly EMS shifts charging behavior to balance devices.

fields.label: Weight by battery size
fields.description: Uses configured battery size to influence how output is shared between devices.

fields.label: SoC reconcile interval
fields.description: How often EMS refreshes and reconciles battery SoC-related state.

groups.title: Expert control tuning
groups.summary: Fine tuning for smoothing, ramps, and fast response.
groups.description: Changes how quickly and smoothly EMS reacts. Wrong values can make control unstable.

sections.title: Grid meter
sections.summary: Meter used as the home power signal.
sections.description: Tells EMS where to read the current grid import or export value.

fields.label: Meter type
fields.description: Selects the device or integration that provides the home grid power value.

fields.label: Meter IP address
fields.description: IP address of the grid meter in your local network, if the selected meter type needs one.

fields.label: Shelly channels
fields.description: Optional Shelly clamp or phase selection. Leave empty to use the meter total.

fields.label: Meter URL
fields.description: Full Tasmota HTTP endpoint. Use this when the default endpoint from the IP is not enough.

fields.label: Power value path
fields.description: Dot-separated JSON path to the current power value.

fields.label: MQTT broker
fields.description: MQTT broker host.

fields.label: MQTT port
fields.description: MQTT broker port.

fields.label: MQTT username
fields.description: Optional MQTT username.

fields.label: MQTT password
fields.description: Optional MQTT password.

fields.label: MQTT topic
fields.description: MQTT topic that contains the current grid power.

fields.label: MQTT payload format
fields.description: Choose whether the topic payload is a plain number or JSON.

fields.label: MQTT value path
fields.description: Dot-separated JSON path to the power value. Required for JSON payloads.

fields.label: MQTT maximum age
fields.description: Maximum age of the last MQTT value before EMS treats it as stale.

shelly.label: Shelly Pro/Plus Gen2/Gen3
shelly.description: Read power from a local Shelly Pro/Plus meter.

shelly_3em_gen1.label: Shelly 3EM Gen1
shelly_3em_gen1.description: Read power from the older Shelly 3EM /status endpoint.

ecotracker.label: everHome EcoTracker
ecotracker.description: Read power from an EcoTracker local API.

zendure_smartmeter_3ct_http.label: Zendure Smart Meter 3CT HTTP
zendure_smartmeter_3ct_http.description: Read grid power from a Zendure Smart Meter 3CT local REST endpoint.

tasmota_http.label: Tasmota HTTP / SmartMeter reader
tasmota_http.description: Read power from a Tasmota HTTP JSON endpoint.

zendure_smartmeter_d0.label: Zendure SmartMeter D0 over MQTT
zendure_smartmeter_d0.description: Read grid power from a Zendure D0 MQTT topic.

mqtt.label: Generic MQTT grid meter
mqtt.description: Read grid power from a custom MQTT topic.

ha.label: Home Assistant grid meter
ha.description: Legacy compatibility only; not recommended for new Admin setups.

sections.title: Devices
sections.description: Add one entry for each inverter or battery-backed device EMS should control.

fields.label: Device name
fields.description: Friendly name shown in logs, dashboard, and Admin pages.

fields.label: Device IP address
fields.description: Local IP address used to reach the device.

fields.label: Serial number
fields.description: Device serial number used by the Zendure API.

fields.label: Smart mode
fields.description: Runtime mode used for live EMS control. Most users should keep the existing value.

fields.label: Device output limit
fields.description: Maximum output this inverter may provide.

fields.label: PV size
fields.description: Approximate PV power connected to this device. Used for power sharing between devices.

fields.label: PV priority
fields.description: Gives this device more or less priority during PV-based balancing.

fields.label: Battery size
fields.description: Battery capacity connected to this device. Used for SoC-aware power sharing.

fields.label: Minimum SoC
fields.description: Lowest battery level EMS should normally allow for this device.

fields.label: Maximum SoC
fields.description: Highest battery level EMS should normally use for this device.

sections.title: Winter mode
sections.summary: Keeps more battery reserve in winter.
sections.description: Raises the minimum battery reserve during selected winter months.

fields.label: Winter mode
fields.description: Keeps more battery reserve during winter months.

fields.label: Winter months
fields.description: Months where the higher winter reserve should be active.

fields.label: Summer minimum SoC
fields.description: Battery reserve used outside the configured winter months.

fields.label: Winter minimum SoC
fields.description: Battery reserve used during the configured winter months.

fields.label: Reserve change step
fields.description: Maximum SoC target change per adjustment step.

fields.label: Adjustment hour
fields.description: Hour of the day when EMS adjusts the seasonal reserve. Use local time.

fields.label: AC charge power
fields.description: Optional AC charging power used by the winter strategy when supported.

sections.title: Battery full-charge assist
sections.description: Temporarily raises the device charge target so batteries can complete a full charge from time to time.

fields.label: Full-charge assist
fields.description: Helps batteries reach a full charge periodically.

fields.label: Full-charge interval
fields.description: How often EMS should try to let a battery reach full charge.

fields.label: Assist window
fields.description: How many days before the target date EMS may start helping the battery reach full charge.

fields.label: Start assist at SoC
fields.description: Battery level from which EMS may start the full-charge assist behavior.

fields.label: Force time
fields.description: Time of day when EMS may force the full-charge attempt if it has not completed naturally.

fields.label: AC charge power
fields.description: AC charging power used during full-charge assist when supported.

fields.label: Use AC charge mode
fields.description: Allows EMS to use AC charge mode during the assist window when supported.

sections.title: Energy savings
sections.summary: Estimates daily savings from measured output.
sections.description: Uses measured inverter output and your electricity price to estimate savings.

fields.label: Energy savings
fields.description: Enables local savings statistics.

fields.label: Electricity price
fields.description: Your electricity price per kWh, used to estimate savings.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency shown for estimated savings.

fields.label: Max sample gap
fields.description: Maximum time gap between samples that still counts as continuous measurement.

fields.label: Time zone
fields.description: Time zone used for daily savings boundaries and reports.

sections.title: Dashboard
sections.description: Provides the local EMS dashboard with live values, history, and optional write controls.

fields.label: Dashboard enabled
fields.description: Starts the local EMS dashboard.

fields.label: Dashboard host
fields.description: Network address the dashboard listens on. Most Docker setups should keep 0.0.0.0.

fields.label: Dashboard port
fields.description: Port used to open the dashboard in a browser.

fields.label: Local history window
fields.description: Number of hours kept in local dashboard history.

fields.label: History write interval
fields.description: How often dashboard history is written locally.

fields.label: Enable HTTPS
fields.description: Enables HTTPS for the local dashboard. Usually not needed behind a trusted reverse proxy.

fields.label: HTTPS certificate file
fields.description: Certificate file used when HTTPS is enabled.

fields.label: HTTPS key file
fields.description: Private key file used when HTTPS is enabled.

fields.label: Auto-generate HTTPS certificate
fields.description: Creates a local self-signed certificate if HTTPS is enabled and no certificate exists.

fields.label: Idle session timeout
fields.description: Logs users out after this many seconds without activity.

fields.label: Maximum session length
fields.description: Logs users out after this maximum total session time.

fields.label: Log buffer size
fields.description: Number of recent log lines kept available for the dashboard.

fields.label: Redact logs
fields.description: Hides sensitive values in dashboard-visible logs when possible.

fields.label: Animation mode
fields.description: Controls dashboard animation intensity. Use reduced or off on slower devices.

sections.title: Analytics / InfluxDB
sections.description: Stores detailed long-term history for analytics charts. Local SQLite history still works when this is disabled.

fields.label: Analytics enabled
fields.description: Enables long-term analytics storage with InfluxDB.

fields.label: InfluxDB mode
fields.description: Choose bundled InfluxDB for Docker, or external for your own InfluxDB server.

fields.label: Auto-initialize bundled InfluxDB
fields.description: Lets setup create bundled InfluxDB secrets and prepare the local service.

fields.label: Auto-sync analytics schema
fields.description: Lets setup apply required buckets, retention rules, and downsampling tasks.

fields.label: Container URL
fields.description: InfluxDB URL used by EMS when it runs inside Docker.

fields.label: Host URL
fields.description: InfluxDB URL used by host-side commands or native EMS runs.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: InfluxDB organization name.

fields.label: Token
fields.description: Direct InfluxDB token. Prefer using the token environment variable or bundled secret file.

fields.label: Token environment variable
fields.description: Environment variable name used to read the InfluxDB token.

fields.label: Bucket prefix
fields.description: Prefix used for EMS analytics buckets.

fields.label: Raw write interval
fields.description: How often raw telemetry is written. Use 0 to write once per EMS control loop.

fields.label: Raw data retention
fields.description: How long high-resolution raw telemetry is kept.

fields.label: 1-minute retention
fields.description: How long 1-minute analytics data is kept.

fields.label: 5-minute retention
fields.description: How long 5-minute analytics data is kept.

fields.label: 1-hour retention
fields.description: How long hourly analytics data is kept.

fields.label: Source bucket
fields.description: Resolution bucket used as input for this downsampling rule.

fields.label: Target bucket
fields.description: Resolution bucket written by this downsampling rule.

fields.label: Window
fields.description: Time window used to aggregate data into the target bucket.

fields.label: Maximum range
fields.description: Largest selected time range where this profile should be used.

fields.label: Data bucket
fields.description: Analytics bucket used for this time range.

fields.label: Query window
fields.description: Aggregation window used when reading data for charts.

groups.title: Retention
groups.summary: How long analytics data is kept.
groups.description: Controls storage periods for each analytics resolution.

groups.title: Downsampling
groups.summary: Creates lower-resolution history for longer time ranges.
groups.description: Combines detailed measurements into longer time windows to reduce storage use.

groups.title: Query profiles
groups.summary: Chooses analytics resolution by selected time range.
groups.description: Selects the data resolution used when charts cover different time ranges.
